name: C4D Product Bundles for WooCommerce
author: coffee4dev

sections.description:
C4D Product Bundles for WooCommerce lets you create a product bundle on any simple or variable WooCommerce product and sell related products together at a discount. Customers tick the items they want, choose their options and add the whole bundle to the cart in one click.

One plugin covers both ways of selling more:

  • Product bundles: sell a set at one price, such as a starter kit, a gift box or a skincare routine. Use a fixed bundle price, or mark every item as must include.
  • Frequently bought together: show items that go with the product, such as a camera with a memory card and a bag, and give a discount that grows with each item the customer ticks.

You don’t need a separate bundle plugin and a separate frequently bought together plugin.

Try the live demo | Docs and setup guide

Why choose this product bundle plugin

  • Variable products in the free version. Customers pick the size or colour of each bundle item on the product page.
  • Bundles customers can adjust. Items can be ticked or unticked and the total updates, or you can mark an item as must include.
  • Flexible bundle pricing. Use a percent or fixed discount, a fixed bundle price, or special item prices that apply only inside the bundle.
  • Clear orders. The cart, checkout, order emails and the order screen all show which items were bought as a bundle.

Create a product bundle

  • AJAX search to find and add products to the bundle
  • Drag and drop to arrange bundle items
  • Set the quantity of each item
  • Choose which items are ticked by default
  • Mark items as must include
  • Set the default variation of a variable item
  • Show the bundle as an extra buying option, or as the main purchase for products sold only as a set

Product bundle pricing and discounts

  • Regular and sale prices calculated automatically from the bundle items
  • Percent or fixed amount discounts
  • Tiered discounts that grow with each item the customer adds, such as 5, 10, 15
  • Fixed price for the whole bundle
  • Discount the added items only and keep the main product at full price
  • Set a price for an item inside the bundle without changing its normal price, including free gifts
  • Start and end dates for limited-time bundle offers
  • Countdown clock, built in

Control how each bundle looks

  • Change the bundle title and description
  • Change the title and short description of each item
  • Show or hide each item’s thumbnail, title, description, quantity, variations, category, attributes and taxonomy
  • Place the bundle anywhere in a page builder layout with the [c4d_woo_bundle] shortcode

Settings for all bundles

Go to C4D Bundles in the dashboard menu to set defaults for every product bundle in your shop:

  • Add to cart button text
  • Bundle or discount badge on the shop page
  • View Bundle button on the shop page
  • Stock status in each item’s variation menu
  • A Custom CSS box for colours and fonts

Premium features

The free version shows the main product plus up to 3 bundled products. Premium adds:

  • More than 3 products in a bundle
  • Fill a bundle automatically from the product’s cross-sells, so you don’t pick items one by one
  • Updates and premium support

Get C4D Product Bundles Pro, from $19 a year.

Compatibility

Tested with WordPress 7.1, WooCommerce 11.2 and PHP 8.4. Works with WooCommerce order tables (HPOS).

More plugins for your WooCommerce store

  • C4D Woo Variation Images: show variations as images, colours or text, with multiple images per variation.
  • C4D Woocommerce Boost Sales: create upsell and cross-sell offers in the mini cart, cart page, popup cart, thank you page and emails.
  • C4D Woocommerce Filter: AJAX product filters without reloading the page.
  • C4D Woocommerce Cart: popup and side cart with cross-sell, upsell and related products.

Support

Ask in the support forum or read the setup guide.

If the plugin works well on your shop, a review helps other store owners find it.
sections.installation:
1. In your WordPress admin, go to Plugins > Add New Plugin and search for “C4D Product Bundles for WooCommerce”. You can also upload c4d-woo-bundle to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate the plugin. WooCommerce must be installed and active.
  3. Open the product that will carry the bundle and go to the Product Bundle tab in the Product data box.
  4. Search for the products to add, set the discount and save the product.
sections.faq:
What is a WooCommerce product bundle?

A product bundle is a group of related products sold together, usually at a discount. With this plugin, the bundle appears on the page of a main product, and customers add the main product and the items they choose to the cart together.

Can I use it for frequently bought together offers?

Yes. Add the items that go with the product, leave them unticked or ticked by default, and set a discount such as 5, 10, 15 so the saving grows with each item the customer adds. The offer appears on the product’s page.

How do I create a product bundle?

Edit a product, open the Product Bundle tab, search for the products to include, set a discount and save. The getting started guide covers each step.

Can I add variable products to a bundle?

Yes, in the free version. Customers choose the variation of each item on the product page, and you can set the variation selected by default.

How many products can a free bundle have?

The main product plus up to 3 bundled products. Premium allows more.

Can I give a bigger discount when customers buy more items?

Yes. Enter several discounts separated by commas, such as 5, 10, 15. The discount used depends on how many bundle items the customer ticks.

Can I sell a bundle at a fixed price?

Yes. Enter a Bundle Price and the plugin uses it in place of the item prices and the main product’s price.

Can I run a product bundle offer for a limited time?

Yes. Set the start and end dates and the bundle only appears between them. You can also show a countdown clock to the end date.

Does it work with page builders?

Add the [c4d_woo_bundle] shortcode to your single product template in Elementor, Divi or another builder to choose where the bundle appears.
sections.changelog:
2.0.1

  • Added: a live demo store, linked from the C4D Bundles settings page and this page, where you can try bundles with up to 6 items.

2.0.0

  • Added: a C4D Bundles menu and settings page. C4D Plugin Manager and Redux are no longer needed.
  • Your existing settings move to the new page automatically. Once you have checked them, you can delete C4D Plugin Manager, unless another C4D plugin still uses it.
  • Changed: colour, font and spacing settings are replaced by a Custom CSS box. Your current styles are moved into it, so your shop looks the same.
  • Removed: discount by user role. Bundles that used it now show a fixed amount off, which is what the cart already charged.
  • Changed: each bundle item is now its own line in the cart and on the order, shown indented under the main product. This works in the classic cart and in the Cart, Checkout and Mini-Cart blocks. Item lines have no remove button or quantity box. Removing the main product removes the whole bundle.
  • Changed: stock is now reduced for every bundle item, and an item that is out of stock makes the bundle unavailable. The main product’s stock is now reduced by the number of bundles times the main product quantity in each bundle (1.x reduced it by the number of bundles only). Orders placed before 2.0.0 never reduced the stock of bundle items, so please check your stock counts.
  • Changed: taxes, shipping and coupons limited to certain products now apply to each product separately. Totals that include tax or shipping can differ from before.
  • Changed: sales reports count each bundle item as its own sale, so the main product’s revenue no longer includes the other items.
  • Old orders keep the display they had. Open carts are converted when the customer loads the next page. A bundle that cannot be converted is removed from the cart with a notice.
  • Going back to 1.x after carts were converted shows the items as separate lines without the bundle discount.
  • Changed: clearer names and descriptions for the settings.
  • Added: a built-in countdown clock. Woo Countdown Sale Product is no longer needed. Bundles with no end date now count down from 15 minutes by default, which you can change at C4D Bundles > Global.
  • Fixed: in a cart with several bundles, a bundle using the shop-wide discount type could be charged with the discount type of the bundle before it. Totals of these carts can change.
  • Fixed: the shop page badge now sits on the product image in block themes.
  • Fixed: Show Item Tag now follows its own setting instead of Show Item Category.
  • Fixed: Show Item Variable Stock Status can now be turned off.
  • Changed: the cart now checks each bundle against the item limit (the main product plus 3 items in the free version). A cart saved with more items than that needs the bundle added again.
  • Added in Pro: bundles with more than 3 items, items taken from the cross-sells of the main product, and plugin updates through your licence.

1.2.0

  • Security: bundle prices are now worked out only from the products saved in the bundle. Before, a changed add-to-cart request could add other products or negative quantities and lower the cart price. Please update.
  • Tested with WordPress 7.1, WooCommerce 11.2 and PHP 8.4.
  • Added: declares compatibility with WooCommerce order tables (HPOS).
  • Added: Requires Plugins header, so WordPress installs WooCommerce first.
  • Fixed: bundle details are saved on orders with the current WooCommerce hook.
  • Fixed: PHP warnings in the cart when a bundle item was deleted.
  • Fixed: bundle settings saved from the product editor are now sanitized.
  • Updated: plugin links point to the new docs page, support forum and reviews.

1.1.2

  • Added: shortcode [c4d_woo_bundle]

1.1.0

  • Added: show product item’s category
  • Added: show product item’s tags
  • Added: show product item’s taxonomies
  • Added: show product item’s attributes
  • Added: discount by user role
  • Added: set default variation for variable product item
  • Added: set specify price for bundle, ignore all item’s price
  • Added: set specify price for each item in bundle only, do not affect the original product.
  • Added: opiton to set product item is checked by default or not.
  • Added: opiton to show variation is in stock, easier for user when seclecting variation

  • Fixed: load language file.

  • Updated: language file

  • Fixed: datepicker error admin

1.0.7

  • Fixed: detect add to cart js

1.0.6

  • Added: Inside Main Product option: bundle is show like as buy option or like main product.
  • Added: Bundle Qty input
